description:
Open the file '/home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/ExamAnxiety.csv' in Jamovi. Create a new Computed Variable named 'AnxietyLevel' based on the 'Anxiety' column using the following logic: if Anxiety is <= 50, label as 'Low'; if Anxiety is > 50 and <= 75, label as 'Medium'; if Anxiety is > 75, label as 'High'. 

Ensure this new variable is treated as Nominal. Then, perform a One-Way ANOVA with 'Exam' as the Dependent Variable and 'AnxietyLevel' as the Grouping Variable. Under 'Assumption Checks', enable 'Homogeneity test' and 'Normality test'. Under 'Post-Hoc Tests', enable 'Tukey'. Under 'Additional Statistics', enable 'Descriptives table'. 

Finally, save the result as '/home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/ExamAnxietyRecoded.omv'.
